exposure: Mode of delivery (Control, Cesarean section, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
Mode of delivery (Cesarean section, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
outcome: Tissue hardness of the internal and external orifice of the cervix (IOC & EOC) measured by shear wave elastography (SWE)
cohort: 48 patients divided into three groups based on mode of delivery: control (no delivery), cesarean section, and spontaneous vaginal delivery
finding: There were no significant differences in cervical tissue hardness (elasticity) between different delivery modes.
mod_finding: Cervical tissue hardness did not differ significantly between cesarean section and spontaneous vaginal delivery groups.
